purpose: Paper-only exploratory test of Jev's UNI return-band judgments and a separate qualitative long-term thesis assessment. This is not a trade instruction or a validation of forecasting skill.
unit_of_analysis: one asset at one verified decision cutoff; a later snapshot of the same asset is a separate case

required: The report cutoff is resolved to an unambiguous UTC timestamp with an explicit timezone.
The reference price and all included features are known to have been observed no later than that cutoff; an independently reproducible study also retains their API endpoints and timestamps.

The user-confirmed API-sourced metrics may be used in a clearly labeled exploratory call even when Codex has not reviewed their original payloads. This limitation must not be described as evidence that the metrics are wrong.
No outcome, future event, or post-cutoff revision appears in the state.

previous_binary_direction_questions: Superseded by the candidate five-band 7d and 30d Choice questions; no binary direction questions are active.

outcome_definition.label_rule: For each 7d or 30d horizon, compute R = 100 * (future price / starting price - 1) and assign exactly one band from uni-questions.draft.json. If either price cannot be recovered under the predeclared sampling rule, the label is missing and the case is excluded from accuracy scoring. Long-term thesis classifications require a separately defined evaluation standard and must not be scored as price-band outcomes.

assessment_plan.single_case: Record the chosen band, all option weights, model version, exact state, and request time; do not call a single prediction an accuracy estimate.
assessment_plan.many_cases: Once labeled point-in-time snapshots exist, compare multi-class hit rate and probabilistic scores against predeclared baselines. Keep chronologically later cases out of any rule tuning.
assessment_plan.interpretation: Choice weights are model outputs, not proven calibrated probabilities of financial profit. A positive return band does not establish a profitable trade after fees or acceptable interim risk.

unresolved_user_choices: Approve or revise the illustrative 7d and 30d return-band boundaries in uni-questions.draft.json.
Keep long-term results as research classifications; define any personal investment objective and risk budget separately before considering a buy/wait/avoid policy.
Choose a single archived UNI/USD price source and a timestamp/price sampling rule for t0 and both future horizons.
Confirm that a calendar month is represented by exactly 30 days for this first test.
